aka: Les 10 catastrophes qui ont marqué la planète
trans_title: Les 10 catastrophes qui ont marqué la planète
introduction: This series will go back through the record to explore life-altering, earth-shattering, unforgettable events using a combination of carefully selected archive, cutting edge CGI and informative scripting in this popular science format. As well as exploring spectacular archive, illustrating the full toll these disasters can take, we’ll dig into the science behind each event, shining a light on the most fascinating elements and giving an understanding on how and why these events occur.S1 E1 MegafloodsS1 E2 ConstructionS1 E3 HurricanesS1 E4 EarthquakesS1 E5 VolcanoesS1 E6 TornadoesS1 E7 Land, Air, SeaS1 E8 IndustrialProduction company: Big Media, RMC ProductionProducers: Ronan Hand, Thibaut Martin, Martin Kase
